2609.21789.title: Per-Aetiology Contrastive Severity Embeddings with Phonological Pseudo-Labelling for Multilingual Dysarthric Speech
2609.21789.paper_summary: Most multilingual dysarthria-severity systems either train on a single aetiology-language pair or pool heterogeneous aetiologies into one label space. We test that pooling assumption with four matched HuBERT-base contrastive embedding models under a shared backbone, training recipe, corpus registry and held-out evaluation: one mixed-aetiology baseline and three aetiology-specific models for cerebral palsy (CP), Parkinson's disease (PD) and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). Training combines clinically labelled speech with ordinal pseudo-labels from a training-free phonological profiling method [1], [2]. On speaker-disjoint, leakage-filtered held-out subsets, the per-aetiology models outperform the mixed baseline across all three target aetiologies: CP (macro F1 0.829 vs 0.676, +22.6 % relative), PD (0.715 vs 0.511, +40.0 %) and ALS (0.788 vs 0.596, +32.3 %). On CP, adding 144 SAP and 44 CDSD pseudo-labelled speakers lifts macro F1 from 0.786 to 0.829 over a clinical-only CP model (+4.3 percentage points). Training data span three to seven languages per aetiology. We position this as a controlled comparison of label-space design choices and discuss pseudo-label calibration, split hygiene, and confidence-thresholded deployment as important limitations for future work.
2609.21789.paper_summary_zh: 大多數多語言的言語不清嚴重程度系統要麼在單一的病因-語言對上進行訓練，要麼將異質的病因合併為一個標籤空間。我們用四個匹配的HuBERT-base對比嵌入模型在共享的骨幹、訓練配方、語料庫登記和保留評估下測試這一合併假設：一個混合病因基線和三個針對腦性麻痺（CP）、帕金森病（PD）和肌萎縮側索硬化症（ALS）的病因特定模型。訓練結合了臨床標記的語音和來自無需訓練的音韻剖析方法的序數偽標籤[1]，[2]。在說話者不重疊、過濾漏洩的保留子集上，針對每種病因的模型在所有三個目標病因上均超越混合基線：CP（宏觀F1 0.829對0.676，+22.6%相對）、PD（0.715對0.511，+40.0%）和ALS（0.788對0.596，+32.3%）。在CP上，添加144個SAP和44個CDSD偽標記的說話者使宏觀F1從0.786提升至0.829，相較於僅臨床的CP模型增加了4.3個百分點。訓練數據涵蓋每種病因的三到七種語言。我們將此視為標籤空間設計選擇的受控比較，並討論偽標籤校準、拆分衛生和基於信心的部署作為未來工作的重大限制。
